speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) due to prematurity at 33 weeks gestation. The onset 2 hours after birth, combined with the arterial blood gas showing respiratory acidosis and hypoxemia, along with the lack of prenatal care, strongly supports this diagnosis. The chest X-ray requested previously would typically show the "ground-glass" appearance and air bronchograms characteristic of surfactant deficiency.
